body_es: AWS proporciona acceso a recursos informáticos globales bajo demanda, eliminando la necesidad de invertir en infraestructura física costosa que debe mantenerse en centros de datos locales. La nube AWS ofrece escalabilidad elástica sin precedentes, permitiendo que las aplicaciones crezcan o se reduzcan automáticamente según la demanda real, sin sobreaprovisionamiento innecesario. Los clientes pagan solo por lo que utilizan mediante un modelo de precios flexible, reduciendo significativamente los gastos de capital inicial y los costos operativos continuos. La disponibilidad global de AWS mediante múltiples regiones geográficas y zonas de disponibilidad en cada región asegura alta disponibilidad y recuperación rápida ante desastres. La seguridad está integrada en todos los niveles de la infraestructura, con cumplimiento de estándares internacionales como ISO, SOC 2, HIPAA y GDPR. AWS continúa innovando constantemente con nuevos servicios y características, manteniendo a los usuarios en la vanguardia de la tecnología sin necesidad de inversión adicional en investigación y desarrollo.
body_en: AWS offers on-demand access to global computing resources, eliminating the need for expensive physical infrastructure investments that must be maintained in local data centers. The AWS cloud provides unprecedented elastic scalability, allowing applications to grow or shrink automatically based on actual demand, without unnecessary over-provisioning. Customers pay only for what they use through flexible pricing models, significantly reducing upfront capital expenses and ongoing operational costs. AWS's global presence through multiple geographic regions and availability zones within each region ensures high availability and rapid disaster recovery capabilities. Security is built into every layer of the infrastructure, with compliance to international standards such as ISO, SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR. AWS continues to innovate constantly with new services and features, keeping users at the cutting edge of technology without additional research and development investment. The shared responsibility model is foundational to cloud architecture: AWS secures the underlying physical infrastructure, multi-region architecture, and hypervisor layers, while customers are responsible for their applications, data, and access controls. Understanding this clear division of responsibilities ensures organizations can focus resources on their business logic rather than data center operations. AWS's innovation velocity means continuous updates to services and features at no additional cost, ensuring organizations benefit from cutting-edge technology without expensive upgrades. The elasticity and global reach combined with pay-as-you-go pricing transform how organizations approach infrastructure investment and scalability planning.
example_code:
# List all AWS regions available to your account
aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output table

# Get your account ID and user information
aws sts get-caller-identity

# List all your EC2 instances across regions
aws ec2 describe-instances --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].{ID:InstanceId,Type:InstanceType,State:State.Name}'
